highlights.title: OpenAI agents hacked an Australian government website in search for data
highlights.description: Sam Altman attends a UN Security Council meeting on AI. | Getty Images OpenAI's artificial intelligence agents hacked an Australian government website and attempted to breach numerous other government and university websites. The attack appears to be the first confirmed instance of a rogue AI agent breaching a government website, adding fuel to rapidly intensifying concerns about the safety of advanced AI systems and the responsibility of the companies building them. devices.title: Apple says software update to fix iPhone 18 Pro rebooting bug is coming next week
devices.description: On Monday, we reported on an issue where iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max users were seeing their phone freeze and reboot following a failed Face ID attempt. To us, it appeared to be a software glitch rather than an inherent hardware fault. Apple has now confirmed to 9to5Mac that a software update to address this problem is in the works, and should be available early next week. more…

robotics.title: Humanoid Robots Spell Opportunity for European Chemical Firms
robotics.description: The humanoid robotics industry relies on one key chemical component used in joints and limbs, creating a battleground for market dominance between European incumbents and Chinese rivals.

other.title: Samsung's disastrous firmware update bricks refrigerators ahead of South Korean holiday
other.description: A broken Samsung update left many refrigerators stuck and non-functional. The incident, which happened right before a major holiday, has many users complaining of spoiled food and a ruined holiday.

other.title: Meta is launching ‘VR Glasses’ next year for $1,300
other.description: Alongside its new audio-only and Ray-Ban smart glasses, Meta today also unveiled new “VR Glasses” which take the experience of a Quest into a far slimmer form factor with an external processing puck. more…

other.title: Meta launches audio-only glasses and Gen 3 Ray-Ban with slimmer designs
other.description: Meta today introduced its new Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 3) smart glasses with a slimmer design and longer battery life alongside a new audio-only lineup, and a new $250 entry-level release. more…

other.title: Why No One Wants to Date Tech Bros
other.description: Once seen as nerdy but harmless innovators, men in tech are now widely regarded as red-pilled Elon Musk wannabes. It’s made getting laid a whole lot harder.

crypto.title: Brooklyn man sent to prison for 12 years for stealing $16M in a Coinbase phishing scheme
crypto.description: The fraudster managed to scam about 100 people across the United States, convincing them of transferring funds to him, claiming their accounts had been hacked.

crypto.title: EU financial watchdogs warn quantum computing poses imminent threat to blockchain encryption
crypto.description: The warning brings renewed urgency to the debate over how bitcoin should deal with legacy addresses whose public keys are already exposed onchain.

crypto.title: A week of AI coding cut a quantum-safe bitcoin transaction estimate from $320 to $66
crypto.description: StarkWare, which conducted the research, says contest participants using AI tools made the computation about five times faster, though the $66 figure has not yet been demonstrated in another transaction mined on Bitcoin.
